summary: Bank of Nova Scotia filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Distribution Agreement dated October 1, 2026 with Scotia Capital (USA) Inc. covering up to U.S.$75 billion of Senior Medium-Term Notes, Series I, plus calculation and exchange-rate agency agreements with Computershare Trust Company, N.A. Notes will issue under the January 22, 2010 base indenture, on a delayed, continuous basis in U.S. dollars or other currencies. This is an ordinary shelf-style debt program, not a special situation; no price, premium or closing date is stated. Watch for takedown pricing and any credit-spread moves.
